findings.title: Coverage raw counts are not scoped to the selected shape
findings.description: Description: `raw_counts()` at `src/manta_trading/data/tick/status_reads.py:154-174` counts every `tick_trade` row in the timestamp window and groups only by `(instrument_id, session_date)`. It does not join `tick_trade.unit_id` — defined at `src/manta_trading/market/schema/migrations/tick.py:222-245` — to current units/requests, while `ledger_totals()` in the same module filters through the shape/current-unit predicate. `_session_row()` at `src/manta_trading/data/tick/tick_coverage.py:75-91` then takes the union of ledger and raw instrument keys, so any raw row from another product/shape in the same time range becomes `Mismatch(ledger=0, raw=N)`, marks coverage mismatched, and makes the CLI exit 3. As soon as more than one product/shape has raw rows in the same window, coverage can report false positives. Scope the raw scan by the same current-unit shape/predicate as the ledger, or by the ledger’s current unit ids.

findings.title: Coverage's tick_trade scan has no resource budget
findings.description: Description: `raw_counts()` at `src/manta_trading/data/tick/status_reads.py:154-174` joins every `tick_trade` row between `min(opens)` and `max(closes)` against an `unnest` array containing every requested session. The CLI accepts arbitrary `--start/--end` at `src/manta_trading/cli/commands/tick_store_cmds.py:205-236`, and `_read()` at `src/manta_trading/cli/commands/tick_store_cmds.py:156-166` opens the connection through `connect_migrated()` without setting a statement timeout; `_connect()` in `src/manta_trading/data/tick/store_context.py:159-167` sets only the connect timeout. The SQL rules require `statement_timeout` for long-running queries and server-side cancellation after client-side timeout. A wide coverage range can hold a large hypertable scan and large session arrays with no server-side cancellation bound. Add a bounded statement timeout or maximum coverage range, and ensure the backend is cancelled after a client-side timeout.

findings.title: New status/coverage paths lack the required load test
findings.description: Description: `build_coverage()` at `src/manta_trading/data/tick/tick_coverage.py:94-115` and `build_status()` at `src/manta_trading/data/tick/tick_status_build.py:230-245` add new DB/calendar/event-loop paths: `asyncio.run`, `asyncio.to_thread`, blocking `TradingCalendar` pools, and the full raw-count scan. The Python rules require a load-tier test for concurrency/network/environment-layer paths that asserts latency, throughput, or resource bounds. `test/load/test_225_tick_ingest_nfr.py:1` covers ingest throughput and event-loop gaps only; the `test/load/` directory contains no status/coverage load test. The new integration tests at `test/integration/data/test_tick_status_cli.py:1-153` and `test/integration/data/test_tick_status_build.py:1-127` seed one or two days, not a realistic range/row count. Add a gated load test that exercises `status` and `coverage` against a realistic tick_trade size and date range and asserts a latency or resource bound.
